text: グレー　バッジを　つけてると　それだけで　きみの　ポケモンは　つよくなる！

structure.jp: グレー　バッジを　つけてると
structure.en: when you're wearing the Gray Badge

structure.jp: きみの　ポケモンは　つよくなる！

patterns.name: 〜と (whenever)
patterns.explanation: と after a verb means that whenever the first thing is true, the next thing always follows. つけてる is the shortened form of つけている. つけてると = 'when you're wearing it'.

patterns.name: 〜だけで
patterns.explanation: だけ means 'only' and で adds 'by', so together they say that nothing more is needed. それだけで = 'just by that alone'.

patterns.name: 〜くなる
patterns.explanation: A describing word with its い changed to く plus なる means to become that way. つよくなる = 'become strong'.
